entry.title: Holy Fawn
entry.content:
The Beginning

Holy Fawn is my most beloved band ever. Ryan Osterman is THE guy, i relate to him in some ways i can not describe, it’s all so relatable, but it feels like i knew them since forever.

It was the summer of 2024, July 11. Was thundering, raining strong. And I was in my room, taking pictures of thunder bolts. Then this song came in on my recommendation. It was matching the vibe, like we say in Uzbekistan “Like a stone set in a ring”.

I am lost, got turned around
Can you tell I am not from this land?

I want to taste, taste all the trees in you
Keep me around, I′ll be something worthwhile

Keep me taught, I will chew through the knots
Make you rethink the day you found me
I'm just lost, I′m just lost
How come you're so far away
With streams down your face?
What made you this way?
Can't you escape?

How come you′re so far away
With streams down your face?
What made you this way?
Can′t you escape?
How come you're so far away?

Burn me down

Burn me down
Burn me down
Burn me down
Listening (burn me down)
The moon sings soft (burn me down)
Cold breathing (burn me down)
Whispering (burn me down)

© Holy Fawn - "hf:/LHPN/seer/REF2.alt"

And then i discovered their more blackmetal rooted works. Most notably the Death Spells album, and the recent Beneath A Lightless Star which reminds me of The Angelic Process, one of my favorite ambient dronemetal creators.

To Be Continued…
